acadsharpResolution.status: ACadSharp does not resolve group 331 in its DXF model. DxfObjectsSectionReader.readLayout stores it in LasActiveViewportHandle (source line 428), while CadLayoutTemplate.build resolves ActiveViewportHandle (line 35). The DXF reader therefore drops the captured handle before graph resolution. Its object model also exposes Viewport targets only; the Model output handle 0x2292 is a VPORT table record. This peer result cannot establish a libdxfrw pointer defect.

namedObjectDictionary.rawLocalSourceAndAsciiComparison: The prior bounded comparison reports the same 15 source/output NOD entries, including ACAD_PLOTSTYLENAME.
namedObjectDictionary.status: ACadSharp inserts default root entries and omits ACAD_PLOTSTYLENAME from its DXF object model even though the existing raw ASCII output comparison finds that key. Its object-model counts are not a faithful NOD parity oracle. Binary NOD semantics remain unqualified.
